# Design

Vira > [Modules](../README.md) > Design

The Design Studio hosted from the design-foundation repo, and the skins Vira can wear.

Vira hosts the design-foundation checkout's studio page and provides
its save path (commit and push there). A skin is a complete `:root` token
set the Design Studio can wear; the Genre Studio compiles jumping-off points
for it.
